name: Mỹ Tho
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Mỹ Tho GIS viewer credits its parcel dataset to Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai tỉnh Tiền Giang and states an update date of October 2024. This names the local provincial land-registration custodian.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the active viewer exposes a full anonymous polygon response versus rendered map only; current ward/administrative boundary changed after 2025 merger and WUP centroid coverage must be checked in the viewer.
scopeLimits: No citywide completeness is asserted. No owner/address/account/token values retained. At most three complete native parcel geometries may be retained for this city; none was obtained.
